description: Requirements registry. Every acceptance criterion (AC) must be referenced by at least one automated check: tag the test name or a comment with [AC-xx] / [QA-xx]. `npm run trace` checks this and writes docs/traceability.md.

requirements.title: Sign in when an action needs an account

criteria.text: Sending a request while signed out asks the user to sign in, and the request is kept for when they return.
Live interpretation will not start for a signed-out user: the server refuses to issue a session key (401).

requirements.title: Use the app in five languages

criteria.text: Every UI phrase has non-empty Korean, Chinese, Japanese and Spanish translations.
Switching between all five languages keeps every screen inside the mobile column with no horizontal overflow.

requirements.title: Find a studio on the list and the map

criteria.text: Topic, area, language and budget filters return only studios that match all of them.
The map renders its pins inside the mobile column even when the Maps key is missing.
A sample studio's page is labelled as a sample, and it never offers a payment action.
A request to a sample studio is labelled a demo request at every step.
The database marks requests to sample studios as demo, schedules the automated reply, and leaves real requests untouched.
The target language is chosen without asking: profile language, then country, then app language, then English. Korean is never the target.
Session keys are issued only to signed-in users from this site, at most 20 per user per hour, and the long-term API key never appears in a response.
Each utterance is shown together with its translation.
A dropped connection is retried up to 3 times (1 s, 2 s, 4 s) with a new key, and the transcript is kept.
Audio is never stored. Transcript text stays only in the browser tab, survives a refresh, and is deleted when the user clears it.
Each turn's delay (end of speech to first translated audio) is measured and summarised as median and 95th percentile.
Invalid input (missing name, name over 80 characters, unknown gender) is rejected before calling the AI.
A result always has hangul, hanja, romanisation and meaning; incomplete AI output is rejected (502).
When the server is unavailable the user still gets a name, from the local fallback.
The day's element comes from the calendar and is the same every time for the same date.
The relation between the user's element and the day's element follows the generating and controlling cycles.
Only a small JPEG, PNG or WebP photo from this site is accepted; anything else is refused before calling the AI.
A reading always has a summary, the three zones, the five features and advice; no clear face or an incomplete reading is reported as such.
The AI reads only gwansang symbolism and is told never to comment on looks, age, ethnicity or health, or to guess identity; the image is sent at low detail.
The photo is shrunk on the device before sending and is never stored, logged or returned.
The face reading page stays inside the mobile column at every width.
The galaxy is generated the same way every time, with bounded, finite star data.
Scrolling down spins it forward, scrolling up spins it back, and it settles to a slow idle spin.
As the hero scrolls away the galaxy tilts open and draws closer, within fixed limits.
The home hero stays inside the mobile column at every width.

quality.title: Interpretation delay
quality.target: p50 ≤ 1.2 s, p95 ≤ 2.0 s from end of speech to first translated audio
quality.measure: npm run eval:interpretation (T-VOICE) and sajuteller_live_session_metrics from real sessions

quality.title: Meaning preserved
quality.target: Glossary term accuracy ≥ 90%; two raters' mean ≥ 4.0/5 with no line ≤ 2
quality.measure: npm run eval:interpretation, then --score on the rated CSV

quality.title: Recovery from a dropped connection
quality.target: Reconnected within 3 attempts (≤ 7 s of waiting); transcript fully kept
quality.measure: Unit tests of the reconnect policy and transcript store; reconnects per session in sajuteller_live_session_metrics

quality.title: Key safety
quality.target: No long-term key in the client bundle; no key issued without sign-in
quality.measure: API tests and the bundle scan in CI

quality.title: Mobile layout
quality.target: Every route stays in the 430 px column with no horizontal overflow at 320–1440 px
